entries.name: University Veterinary Teaching Hospital Sydney (Camperdown)
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Emergency cases do not need an appointment.
entries.note: Contact page: 'Open 24 hours, 365 days a year'; emergency page: 'open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year'. University of Sydney.

entries.name: University Veterinary Teaching Hospital Camden
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm. No 24-hour small animal emergency care; use a 24-hour hospital after hours.
entries.note: Page: small animal services no longer include 24-hour emergency care; livestock/equine on-farm emergency 24/7 (not listed as small animal).

entries.name: SASH North Ryde
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. No booking needed for emergencies; cases are triaged on arrival.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours - 365 days per year'. Phone on page; sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au lists a different number (02 9199 8935) for SASH, 9889 0289 confirmed on the SASH locations page; the 9199 8935 number is from a third-party page.

entries.name: SASH Alexandria
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. No booking needed for emergencies.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours - 365 days per year'.

entries.name: SASH Northern Beaches
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, including weekends and public holidays. No appointment needed for emergencies.
entries.note: Page: open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

entries.name: SASH Central Coast
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 365 days a year. Walk-in emergencies welcome without an appointment.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours, 365 days per year'.

entries.name: SASH Western Sydney
entries.duty: 24-hour emergency care.
entries.note: Locations page lists 'Western Sydney 24/7', 1 Rowood Road, Prospect NSW 2148, (02) 8609 9444; state/nsw page also says '24/7 emergency and specialist veterinary care'. The 'Opening November 9th' text on that page belongs to Perth, not Prospect. sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au lists a different number (02 9199 8935) for Prospect; own page number used. The page has no explicit opening date for Prospect, so confirm status.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Homebush
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including public holidays. Specialist consultations by referral, Mon-Fri 8am to 6pm.
entries.note: Page: 'open 24 hours, 365 days'.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Gosford
entries.address: Unit 3, 401 Manns Road, West Gosford NSW 2250
entries.duty: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, every day of the year.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, every day of the year'.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Wollongong
entries.duty: Open 24 hours on Saturday and Sunday, and after hours Monday to Friday, including public holidays. Call ahead for weekday opening times.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24 hours Sat-Sun, and after hours Mon-Fri'; not 24 h every day so flag false.

entries.name: Animal Referral and Emergency Centre (AREC) Newcastle
entries.duty: Open 24/7 for emergencies. Please call before bringing your pet in.
entries.note: Contact page: 'open 24/7 for emergencies'; home page: 24/7 emergency and referral care. Brunker Road Vets page gave a second Broadmeadow address (4 Lang Road); AREC pages used.

entries.name: Veterinary Specialists of Sydney (VSOS)
entries.duty: Specialist and emergency hospital in the Sutherland Shire. Call ahead to confirm opening hours.
entries.note: Downgraded by checker: the 24/7 claim rests only on a June 2020 news article (no phone, no clinic name); vsos.com.au could not be opened (provenance) and the emergency-care page gives name, address and phone but no hours. Re-verify on the clinic's own site.

entries.name: Northside Emergency Veterinary Service (NEVS)
entries.address: 335 Mona Vale Road, Terrey Hills NSW 2084
entries.duty: Open 24/7 emergency service on Sydney's northern side.
entries.note: Source is Sydney Animal Hospitals page ('NEVS ... Open 24/7'); nevs.net.au itself could not be opened (provenance). Third-party 24/7 claim, explicit on the page. Address conflict: sydneyanimalhospitals.com.au/emergency-care lists 16 Myoora Road, Terrey Hills; source page lists 335 Mona Vale Road; phone (02) 9452 2933 identical on both. Confirm address before relying on it.

entries.name: Sydney Animal Hospitals Newport
entries.duty: Open 7 days, 7:30am to 7pm. Not a 24-hour hospital; after hours use NEVS Terrey Hills or SASH.
entries.note: Emergency-care page lists a different phone (02 9519 4111) for Newport; location page number used.

entries.name: Sydney Animal Hospitals Avalon
entries.duty: Monday to Friday 8am to 7pm, Saturday 8:30am to 4pm. Closed Sundays and public holidays. Not a 24-hour hospital.
entries.note: Same page as Newport.

entries.name: Cardiff Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Tue 8am to 6pm, Wed-Fri 8am to 8pm, Sat-Sun 8am to 4pm. After hours call ahead and go to a 24-hour emergency centre.
entries.note: Page: not a 24-hour hospital; refers to AREC Broadmeadow and SASH Tuggerah.

entries.name: Brunker Road Veterinary Centre
entries.duty: After hours call the clinic first; emergencies are referred to a 24-hour emergency centre.
entries.note: Page names Newcastle Animal Emergency Centre (11 Perth Road / 4 Lang Road, (02) 4957 7106, i.e. AREC) and SASH Tuggerah as after-hours options. Clinic hours Mon-Fri 8am-6:30pm, Sat 8am-4pm, closed Sun and public holidays.

entries.name: Australian Animal Poisons Helpline
entries.duty: 24/7 animal poisons helpline for Australian pet owners. A consultation fee applies (from AUD 79).
entries.note: Page: '24/7 Helpline For Australian Pet Owners', 'from $79 AUD'. 1300 number is Australia-only (not dialable with +61 prefix); kept in domestic format.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Baulkham Hills
entries.address: 19 Old Northern Road, Baulkham Hills NSW 2153
entries.duty: After-hours emergency hospital. Listed hours: Monday to Friday 6pm to 7am, open 24 hours on weekends; public holiday hours vary, so call ahead.
entries.note: Page header says Mon-Fri 6pm-7am and 'Open 24hrs on weekends'; Facilities section says 24 h on Fri, Sat, Sun, Mon and public holidays (inconsistent), so not flagged 24 h. Clinic page ARH_Baulkham_Hills.html shows no phone.

entries.name: Animal Referral Hospital (ARH) Greater Western Sydney
entries.duty: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, every day of the year.
entries.note: Page: 'We are open 24/7 for our community and their beloved pets!'; meta: 'Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, every day of the year.' Email minchinbury@arhvets.com.
entries.quote: We are open 24/7 for our community and their beloved pets!

entries.name: Coffs Harbour Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 8:30am-12pm, closed Sunday and public holidays. After hours: Coffs District Combined Veterinary After-Hours Emergency Service, 02 6699 3356.
entries.note: No 24 h claim on page; CCVAS uses on-call vets from Coffs Harbour, Moonee and Woolgoolga practices; service hours not stated.

entries.name: Blue and White Vet Coffs Harbour
entries.duty: Mon-Sat 8am-11:30am and 3pm-5:30pm. Sundays and after hours for emergencies or by appointment; call and listen to the recorded message.
entries.note: No 24 h claim. Same group has a Nambucca Heads clinic (1/42 Bowra St, (02) 5522 1030) not added separately.

entries.name: Moonee Beach Veterinary Surgery
entries.address: 2C Moonee Beach Rd, Moonee Beach NSW 2450
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 8:30am-12pm, closed Sunday. After-hours emergency service available; call the clinic.
entries.note: Home page says 'Emergency After Hours Service Available'; no number or hours given. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Oxley Highway Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, closed weekends and public holidays. Emergencies in business hours: call ahead. Out of hours, contact the nearest emergency centre.
entries.note: No 24 h claim; no after-hours service described.

entries.name: Port Macquarie Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-12pm.
entries.note: No after-hours arrangements on home page; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: East Port Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm, Sat 9am-12pm, closed Sunday and public holidays. Emergencies in business hours: call ahead.
entries.note: No 24 h claim; page mentions a VetChat call service for emergencies, not a 24 h clinic.

entries.name: Wauchope Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5pm, Sat 8:30am-11am. Out-of-hours emergencies: call the duty vet; an after-hours fee applies.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Tamworth Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: 24-hour emergency service: call the practice and listen to the recorded message to reach the vet on duty. Consultations by appointment Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 8:30am-12pm.
entries.note: Page: 'We offer 24hr emergency service.' On-call vet via phone, not an overnight-staffed hospital as far as the page says.
entries.quote: We offer 24hr emergency service. Please call the practice and listen to the recorded message which will put you in touch with the veterinarian on duty.

entries.name: Goonoo Goonoo Road Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-1pm, closed Sunday. After hours: 0409 487 486.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Orange Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: 24/7 after-hours service with a vet on duty, 365 days a year. Hours Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 8:30am-12pm.
entries.note: Page: '24/7 after hours service with a vet on duty 365 days of the year' (on-call; no separate number given). Also runs Molong Vet Clinic, 89 Bank St, Molong, (02) 6366 9021.
entries.quote: 24/7 after hours service with a vet on duty 365 days of the year

entries.name: Mulberry Lane Vet Hospital
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8:30am-6pm, Wed 8:30am-5pm, Sat 8:30am-11am. The clinic number is answered 24 hours a day by the on-call vet for urgent cases.
entries.note: 24 h applies to the phone line only, hospital not stated as open 24 h, so emergency_24h false.

entries.name: Canobolas Family Pet Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 9am-4pm, Sun 11am-3pm, closed public holidays. After-hours emergencies: call the clinic number.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Bathurst Central Animal Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, closed weekends and public holidays. After hours: the clinic refers emergencies to ARH Homebush, (02) 9758 8666.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Stewart Street Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-6pm, Sat 9am-5:30pm, closed Sunday. After-hours calls on the same number.
entries.note: Only the page meta description says '24-hour emergency Vet'; visible text does not, so emergency_24h false. vetonbathurst.com refused (robots_disallowed).

entries.name: Wagga Wagga Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Veterinary care available 24/7 every day of the year via the on-call service. Hours Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-12pm.
entries.note: Facilities page: 'Veterinary care available 24-7, every day of the year' next to 'after-hours emergency only service'; home page gives address, phone and '24 on-call service'. Postcode not on page.
entries.quote: Veterinary care available 24-7, every day of the year.

entries.name: Lake Road Veterinary Hospital
entries.address: 60 Lake Albert Rd, Wagga Wagga NSW 2650
entries.duty: 24-hour emergency hospital, staffed around the clock every day of the year.
entries.note: Page title 'Lake Road Vet 24 Hour Emergency Hospital'; 'the only 24-hour veterinary hospital between Canberra/ACT, Bendigo/VIC and Adelaide/SA'. Albury clinics also refer to it. Fetched on second attempt after one server error.
entries.quote: Lake Road Veterinary Hospital is the only 24-hour veterinary hospital between Canberra/ACT, Bendigo/VIC and Adelaide/SA.

entries.name: Family Vet Centre Albury
entries.duty: Weekdays 8am-6pm. Emergencies at any time: call 02 6041 2522 (after-hours vet on call until 10pm for existing clients). After 10pm, the nearest 24-hour clinic is Lake Road Veterinary Clinic in Wagga Wagga.
entries.note: No 24 h claim. Wodonga clinic is in Victoria and not added. Postcode 2640 is not on the page.

entries.name: Albury Animal Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-1pm. Limited on-call evening cover; for other times the nearest 24/7 emergency hospital is Lake Road Veterinary Centre in Wagga Wagga.
entries.note: No 24 h claim. River Country AEC site refused (robots_disallowed).

entries.name: Fur Life Vet Dubbo
entries.duty: Out-of-hours emergencies: call the clinic number to reach the after-hours triage team.
entries.note: '24-hour' appears only in the URL; page text makes no 24 h claim. Hours not on that page.

entries.name: Pet Medical Centre Dubbo
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 8:30am-12:30pm, closed Sunday. After-hours vet service available for emergencies that cannot wait; call the clinic.
entries.note: Page does not use '24 hours' (says 'at any time' / 'round-the-clock care' for hospitalised pets).

entries.name: Duncan McGinness Veterinary Surgeon
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-6pm, Sat 8:30am-1pm. No after-hours service; for emergencies contact Orana Veterinary Services or another clinic.
entries.note: Page states no after-hours services. Small-animal scope inferred from puppy preschool/bird sexing; practice may also treat other species.

entries.name: North Hill Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Out-of-hours emergencies: call the clinic number to reach the after-hours triage team.
entries.note: '24-hour' only in URL; no 24 h claim in text. Street address from the page's map link; hours not on page. Postcode not on page (2350 is Armidale).

entries.name: New England Veterinary Services
entries.duty: Open 24/7 for emergencies. Hours Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-12pm, closed Sunday.
entries.note: Page: 'Open 24/7 for Emergencies'; on-call shared with Uralla Vet Clinic.

entries.name: MyVet Byron Bay
entries.address: Unit 1, 70 Centennial Circuit, Byron Bay NSW 2481
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Sat 8am-12pm, closed Sunday and public holidays. After hours: North Coast Emergency Vets, (02) 7255 4095.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Byron Bay Vet
entries.duty: Handles most emergencies in business hours, including tick paralysis, road accidents and snake bites. After hours: Animal Emergency Service or North Coast Emergency Vets.
entries.note: Address and hours not on the emergencies page. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: North Coast Emergency Vet (Animal Emergency Service North Coast)
entries.address: Unit 1 Bangalow Business Centre, 1 Dudgeons Ln, Bangalow NSW 2479
entries.duty: Emergency vet for the Northern Rivers. Listed hours vary by day (24 hours Saturday, Sunday and Monday, shorter hours Tuesday to Friday); call before travelling.
entries.note: Page claims 'open 24 hours, 7 days a week, 365 days a year' but its own hours list shows set hours Tue-Fri (Tue 12am-5pm, Wed/Thu 7:30am-5pm, Fri 7:30am-12am); Byron Bay Vet page says NCEV covers Friday night to Monday morning. Conflicting, so emergency_24h false pending phone check.

entries.name: Ballina Coast Vets
entries.duty: Mon-Thu 7am-7pm, Fri 7am-5pm, Sat 8am-12pm, Sunday emergency only. On-call service outside these hours.
entries.note: No 24 h claim; phone given as 6686 9333 without area code.

entries.name: Lismore Vet Clinic
entries.duty: Available 24/7 for after-hours emergencies on the clinic number. Hours Mon-Fri 8:30am-6pm, Sat 8:30am-12:30pm, closed Sunday.
entries.note: Home page: 'available 24/7 for after-hours emergencies'; on-call, not stated as overnight on-site staffing.

entries.name: North Nowra Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, Sat 9am-4pm, Sun 9am-1pm (lunch closure 1-2pm Mon-Sat). After hours: phone the clinic to be directed to the after-hours mobile.
entries.note: No 24 h claim. nowravets.com refused/failed twice (client_error), skipped.

entries.name: Jervis Bay Veterinary Clinic
entries.address: 233 The Wool Rd, Old Erowal Bay NSW 2540
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm (closed 1-2pm), closed weekends. After hours: phone the clinic to be directed to the after-hours mobile.
entries.note: Same group as North Nowra Veterinary Hospital. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Bomaderry Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: After-hours service gives 24/7 assistance in emergencies; call 02 4421 3133. Clinic hours Mon-Fri 8am-6pm, weekend appointments 9am-1pm.
entries.note: Page: 'after hours service provides you 24/7 assistance in emergencies' (service, not an overnight hospital). Other sites: Culburra Beach (02 4421 3528), Shoalhaven Heads (02 4448 5621).
entries.quote: after hours service provides you 24/7 assistance in emergencies

entries.name: West Queanbeyan Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Weekdays 8am-6pm, Sat 8:30am-2pm, Sun 2pm-5pm (emergencies only), public holidays 3pm-5pm (emergencies only).
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Queanbeyan Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8am-6:30pm, Sat 8am-12pm, closed Sunday.
entries.note: No address or after-hours detail on the services page; no 24 h claim.

entries.name: Raymond Terrace Veterinary Clinic
entries.address: 63 Port Stephens Street, Raymond Terrace NSW 2324
entries.duty: Weekdays 9am-5:30pm, Sat 9am-11am, closed Sunday. After-hours emergency service for the clinic's clients via answering service; may be referred to a Newcastle emergency centre.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Golf Course Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 8am-5pm, Sat 8am-12pm; closed Thursday, Sunday and public holidays.
entries.note: Page headed 'Emergency Vets in Taree' but gives only daytime hours; no 24 h claim. tareevet.com.au refused (robots_disallowed).

entries.name: Murwillumbah Veterinary Clinic
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:30pm, Sat 8:30am-12:30pm. After-hours emergencies: on-call vet via the clinic number (surcharge applies), or Animal Emergency Services 07 5530 6370.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Lake Vet Belmont
entries.duty: After hours: phone Newcastle Animal Referral and Emergency Centre on 02 4957 7106.
entries.note: Opening hours not on the contact page. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Lake Vet Swansea
entries.duty: By appointment. After hours: phone Charlestown (02 4943 6066) or Belmont (02 4945 9677).
entries.note: Opening hours not on the contact page. No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Charlestown Vet Clinic
entries.duty: Weekdays 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-12pm. Phone first for emergencies; some cases are referred to the Newcastle emergency centre in Broadmeadow.
entries.note: No 24 h claim.

entries.name: Merewether Veterinary Hospital
entries.duty: Open 7 days. When closed, emergency care is provided by AREC in Newcastle and SASH Tuggerah.
entries.note: The 24-hour wording refers to partner facilities, not this clinic.

notes: NSW run 1. Not covered: regional towns (Coffs Harbour, Port Macquarie, Byron, Tamworth, Orange, Wagga, Albury, Dubbo) - searches returned only aggregators, no clinic own pages opened. Not opened: ARH Baulkham Hills, ARH Greater Western Sydney (Minchinbury), SASH Rosebery/other referral pages, nevs.net.au, vsos.com.au (provenance refused), AVA and NSW VPB pages. Other Australian states not covered. NSW run 2: added 42 entries (ARH Baulkham Hills and Minchinbury, regional clinics from their own sites in Coffs Harbour, Port Macquarie, Tamworth, Orange, Bathurst, Wagga Wagga, Albury, Dubbo, Armidale, Byron/Bangalow, Ballina, Lismore, Nowra, Queanbeyan, Murwillumbah, Taree, Newcastle/Lake Macquarie). Not covered: SASH Rosebery (no such SASH location on sashvets.com/about-sash), Pacific Vet Care Coffs Harbour, Vet on Bathurst, Taree Veterinary Hospital, River Country AEC, Moorong Vet Wagga, vetwagga.com.au, Nowra Veterinary Hospital (robots_disallowed or fetch errors twice), Grafton, Kempsey, Tweed Heads, Maitland/Cessnock, Moree, Broken Hill, Goulburn, Cooma, and the AVA / NSW VPB pages (no emergency list found). Other Australian states not covered.
